name: Women's Class B blue blouse, short sleeve: Honor Guard white parade gloves (folded under the belt or the flag sling) (overlay, registered to garment-blues-class-b-blouse-female)
size_basis: Not dimensioned in CAPR 39-1. The folded pair is the guidance figure's, measured against the figure's own pistol belt (96.1, 95.6 and 95.4 px = 2 1/16 in, 46.4 px/in): 3.45 x 5.77 in, 1.99 to 5.44 in from the buckle's centre line, 0.41 in above the belt's upper edge. Same box as garment-blues-class-b-blouse-female.
provenance: in-house vector. Measured on the Class B short sleeve figure of "CAP Honor Guard Uniform Guidance" (page 4, 3672 x 4752 px): the glove's flat fill (249 grey, 24,014 px, 157 x 263 px) isolated as a mask; its contour is the level line 3.0 px outside the fill (the stroke's centre line, measured on the stroke's skeleton: median 3.00 px) and is fitted as cubic curves (corners kept) after Gaussian smoothing; the second glove behind it is the same contour moved (-5.4, +6.1) px (iterative alignment of the two contours, 0.94 px mean). Belt frame: buckle plate outline 1242.5 to 1370.8 px, centre x 1306.5, belt upper edge the line y = 1909.57 - 0.0171 (x - 1306.5) (tilt -0.98 degree, levelled); the belt is 95.4 px tall at the glove, the figure's belts 96.1 and 95.6 elsewhere = 2 1/16 in, so 46.4 px/in. The glove's rim lies 0.41 in above the belt's upper edge and its left edge 1.99 in from the buckle's centre line (over the right-hand keeper, which sits 2.22 in from it). Placed on this sheet from the belt overlay's own position: buckle centre x 12.59 in, belt upper edge y 21.32 in; under the flag sling's band: its upper edge y 21.52 in (the figure draws no sling on this cut: placed by analogy).

landmarks_note: user units 0.01 in; front / rear = contours of the two gloves; extent = {x,y,w_in,h_in}; sheet_box = the garment sheet's own box (the same as this overlay's)

dimensions.form: pair of white parade gloves folded under the belt, palm out, tops over the belt, fingers down; the second glove lies behind the first

scale.rule: the hardware scale: the figures' own 2 1/16 in pistol belts are 96.1, 95.6 and 95.4 px

dimensions.layering: draw over the sheet, over the Honor Guard pistol belt (or flag sling) and over its ascot; the gloves fold over the belt, so nothing of the belt lies over them

sheet_box.note: the overlay's box is the sheet's box

show.flag_bearer: gloves-under-sling (hidden in the file), and hide gloves-under-belt

documented: white parade gloves; worn with the top of the glove just above the wrist providing a neat appearance (CAPR 39-1 9.6.7.7)
when not worn, fold with palm out, place under web belt so that the tops of gloves fold over the top of the belt (9.6.7.7)
white parade gloves are part of the Honor Guard uniform (9.6.1.2)
assumed: the same folded pair is used for the flag bearer: the figure draws no sling on this cut; the pair sits at the same distance from the centre line, its tops over the band's upper edge
the figure draws the pair against the Class B short sleeve shirt; the women's blouse takes the same drawing
the gloves hang over the trousers or slacks; nothing of the sheet below the belt is drawn to meet them
